body:
_Migrated from issue #872, filed 2026-07-13._

In the new UI, an ordinary shelf's back-link reads "< All shelves" and returns to `/shelves`, while a smart shelf's back-link reads "< Library" and returns to `/`. Part of the shelf-parity umbrella #867.

Root cause: `/shelves` (`frontend/src/pages/Shelves.tsx`, `useShelves`) lists ordinary shelves only. Smart shelves have no list page at all — they surface only in the sidebar — so `frontend/src/pages/MagicShelfView.tsx:54,64` falls back to the library. Fix both at the source:

- List the user's smart shelves on `/shelves` in their own section (use `useMagicShelves`, `queries.ts:842`), linking each to `/magic/<id>`.
- Point `MagicShelfView.tsx`'s back-link at `/shelves` with the same "All shelves" label ordinary shelves use (`Shelf.tsx:82,160`).

This makes the two back-links consistent and gives smart shelves a discoverable home beyond the sidebar.

Credit: @auspex (#867).
title: New UI: List smart shelves on /shelves + consistent back-links
